files.hooks/kind.ts:
// コマンドの中身から作業の種類を決める。色分けの元になる
export type Kind = 'check' | 'git' | 'write' | 'read' | 'other'

export const KIND_LABEL: Record<Kind, string> = {
  read: '調べる',
  write: '書き換え',
  check: '検証',
  git: 'git',
  other: 'その他',
}
export const KIND_COLOR: Record<Kind, string> = {
  read: 'suggestion',
  write: 'warning',
  check: 'merged',
  git: 'success',
  other: 'inactive',
}
// 色だけに頼らず形でも見分けられるよう、種類ごとに記号を変える
export const KIND_MARK: Record<Kind, string> = {
  read: '●',
  write: '✎',
  check: '▲',
  git: '⑂',
  other: '・',
}
// 凡例に並べる順
export const KIND_ORDER: Kind[] = ['read', 'write', 'check', 'git', 'other']

const CHECK = /(^|[\s;&|(])(npm (run )?test|pnpm (run )?test|yarn test|vitest|jest|tsc|eslint|validate|plugin test|pytest|shellcheck|lint)\b/
const GIT = /(^|[\s;&|(])(git|gh)\s/
const WRITE = /(^|[\s;&|(])(sed -i|cp|mv|mkdir|rm|touch|tee|chmod|ln|python3? -|cat\s*>)\s|[^>]>\s*(?!\/dev\/null\b)[^&\s]/
const READ = /(^|[\s;&|(])(ls|grep|rg|find|cat|head|tail|sed -n|wc|awk|less|tree|stat|which|file)\b/

export const classify = (command: string): Kind =>
  CHECK.test(command) ? 'check'
  : GIT.test(command) ? 'git'
  : WRITE.test(command) ? 'write'
  : READ.test(command) ? 'read'
  : 'other'
files.hooks/mask.ts:
// 秘密の値に見える文字列を伏せ字にする。記録と表示の前に必ず通す
const PATTERNS: RegExp[] = [
  /-----BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY-----[\s\S]*?(-----END [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY-----|$)/g,
  /\b(gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}|github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{20,})\b/g,
  /\b(sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,}|xox[abprs]-[A-Za-z0-9-]{10,}|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|AIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{30,})\b/g,
  /\b(eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,})\b/g,
]
// 名前に秘密らしい語を含む代入・指定の値
const NAMED = /\b([A-Za-z0-9_]*(?:TOKEN|SECRET|PASSWORD|PASSWD|PASS|API_?KEY|PRIVATE_?KEY|CREDENTIAL)[A-Za-z0-9_]*)(\s*[=:]\s*|\s+)("[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^\s"']+)/gi
const BEARER = /\b(Bearer|Basic|token)\s+[A-Za-z0-9._~+/=-]{8,}/gi
const URL_USERINFO = /(\b[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:\/\/)[^\s/@:]+:[^\s/@]+@/gi
const FLAG = /(--?(?:password|passwd|token|secret|api-key|apikey)(?:=|\s+))("[^"]*"|'[^']*'|\S+)/gi

export const MASK = '•••'

export const mask = (text: string): string => {
  let out = text
  for (const pattern of PATTERNS) out = out.replace(pattern, MASK)
  out = out.replace(URL_USERINFO, `$1${MASK}@`)
  out = out.replace(BEARER, (_m, kind: string) => `${kind} ${MASK}`)
  out = out.replace(FLAG, (_m, flag: string) => `${flag}${MASK}`)
  out = out.replace(NAMED, (_m, name: string, sep: string) => `${name}${sep}${MASK}`)
  return out
}
